Subject: Quick technical screen before demo

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the quick onboarding flow — I signed up through the self-serve last week and poked around the hosted API. Before we schedule a full demo for our product and infra leads, we'd like a very short (15-minute) technical triage to make sure Redwood fits our latency and data residency needs.

High-level items we'd like to cover:
- Typical 99th percentile latency for <1024 tokens (p95/p99) on hosted plan
- How KV cache behaves for multi-user workloads
- Data deletion/retention guarantees for demo/test data

We're based in PST and can do short windows tomorrow morning. Proposed times: 2026-08-31 09:30 AM, 10:00 AM, or 11:15 AM PT. If none of those work, I'm happy to take a Calendly link.

I've attached a one-page org chart and a short doc with our expected QPS.

Thanks —

leo@retailstack.io

Neha (cc'd) is on our SDR/solutions side and will coordinate the short triage. To make the 15 minutes productive, can you confirm a couple of quick things before we hop on:
- Typical prompt length / median tokens and any max sequence lengths we should test

I'm available at 10:00 AM PT tomorrow if that helps, otherwise please pick any open slot from this 15-min page: https://calendly.com/redwood/15min-triage.
